_inputs: Meshy-native per-clip FBX at assets/raw/thug/ (gitignored), each one rigged+skinned mesh; the renderer normalises them to a SHARED scale so they line up. Paths below are the actual Meshy export filenames. Meshy clips can carry root translation (no 'In Place' option) — inPlace:true strips locomotion TRAVEL on import (root bone re-centred over world origin each frame, Z bob kept). If a clip's FBX carries more than one action, the importer drops contaminating guard/hook baselayers and picks the real clip (set per-action `actionName` to pin an exact take). If a literal path is missing the renderer keyword-resolves from this folder. attack=Punch_Combo_1 (non-loop, plays once).

camera._note: 2:1 tiles -> dimetric2to1 (60deg from top-down) is the EXACT match (same lock as #48). modelForwardDeg calibrates the rig's facing: if the gangster faces the wrong way in-game, try 180 here (Mixamo's forward axis often flips on FBX import) OR use the runtime dirOffset in unitSpriteView. dir0 = model yaw `dirStartDeg+modelForwardDeg`, increasing clockwise in 45deg steps; the ingest's FACING_TO_DIR maps grid facing -> row.
